metadata.title: HPC Fabric and Accelerator Trust

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring the secure and predictable use of high-performance interconnects and accelerators in shared HPC environments.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: HPC interconnect fabrics, RDMA-capable networks, GPUs, TPUs, FPGAs, and other shared accelerators and memory systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing trust, isolation, and residual risk for performance-oriented fabrics and accelerators in HPC environments.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Fabric and accelerator trust assumes scheduler-mediated execution on shared HPC platforms.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Fabric and accelerator security relies on correct job lifecycle enforcement and cleanup.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Interconnect, accelerator, residual state, and performance–security trade-off considerations defined in NIST SP 800-234.

metadata.remarks: HPC Fabric and Accelerator Trust defines trust properties for high-performance networking fabrics and shared accelerators that often bypass traditional OS controls in favor of performance. This pattern explicitly models isolation, residual state, and side-channel risks associated with RDMA, GPU contexts, and tightly coupled compute fabrics.

components.title: HPC Interconnect Isolation
components.description: Isolation and governance of high-performance interconnects used by concurrent HPC jobs.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring or interception of data traversing shared high-performance interconnects.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Segmentation and isolation of job traffic over RDMA and HPC fabrics.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection for job traffic over HPC interconnects.
Information flow control between job-specific fabric endpoints.

components.title: HPC Accelerator Context Isolation
components.description: Isolation of accelerator execution contexts between concurrent or successive jobs.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Cross-context interference or data leakage via shared accelerator memory or execution state.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation of accelerator contexts and execution environments per job.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Separation of execution domains for shared accelerator resources.
Least privilege enforcement for access to accelerator devices.

components.title: HPC Residual State Mitigation
components.description: Mitigation of residual execution state and side-channel risk following job completion.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection of residual data from shared memory, accelerator state, or caches after job completion.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Clearing and sanitization of memory and accelerator state between jobs.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controlled removal and sanitization of shared memory and accelerator state.
Integrity protection against unauthorized data persistence across jobs.
